criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Clears the bold register (preflight medians 3.1, 1.0, 3.1, 0.79 to 0.86 near black). Primitive models and small subjects: 1's vented-box monitor back and lights floating above the horizon; 3's carts a tenth of the width each; 4 and 5's barrier an extruded bar chart; 6's smooth extrusions, crate sleeves and dead lower band; 7's flat bars on streaky veneer. 8 and 9 strongest.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One cart, one powder coat, one cold flood, one dark apron; the swivel and the held camera work; value stays dark. 7 sits outside and the interiors change the ground.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the drawn geometry measures true; every source primary; the rejected list honoured. Looser places: slide 5 plots a different model's C-index from zero against slide 4's half tick with no chance line; slide 6 omits that item 65 sat on the August 12th to 13th consent agenda (c27); the 100 lights understate by design, labelled.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where are clear and the law's duty is exact. The Regents action depends on an agenda nothing in the record shows; 'A patient can ask' is the real action, stated generally.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: 2 pays at once, the turn on 5 is declared, the bookend lands. The cover hook is cryptic; 3 and 6 could go without loss.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register, no house-rule breaks. Several deks narrate the drawing; Texas specificity is thin.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No. 27's instrument and angle, no. 43's UT System health AI four days ago, no. 23's radiomics finding on slide 5, and the house technique of nos. 40 to 46.

one_sentence_fix: Replace slide 5's recycled radiomics comparator with the deck's own counted absences in figures.json, and cut or fold frame 3 to give the turn room.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Four carts a tenth of the width each in one thin band, a void above, an empty apron below.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera at 0.6 m, 3 m off the nearest cart, the row receding on a diagonal from a near cart at 45 percent of the frame height.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Smooth extrusions, crate sleeves, a dead bottom 15 percent.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Spangled galvanized maps, bolted plates and contact grime, a low raking key for long shadows across the lower band, crop the dead bottom.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A square-on box that reads as an extruded bar chart, the cart a small prop (5 shares it).
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera at 0.5 m yawed 20 degrees so the barrier recedes with chipped arrises, the cart a third of the frame tall.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A primitive vented monitor back; the lights float above the horizon.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A VESA arm, cable runs and a moulded rear with a cool rim; the lights on the ground at the horizon, spread in depth.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat grey bars on streaky veneer, no curl, shadow or screen light.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A curl and contact shadow, lit from frame left by the screen's cool spill so it is the brightest surface.
